_comment: Headless implementer CLIs for delegate-task.sh and /ejadtask. {prompt} is replaced by the task text. Tools are allowed per CLI through scoped rules, never blanket auto-approve: Copilot by --allow-tool/--deny-tool here; Kilo and Antigravity by the allow rules in their own settings files (see the README). Default is opencode (OpenCode Go), whose policy is the ejad-approvals plugin.
